verdict.rationale: Gmail's first-party docs clearly document snoozing: emails leave the inbox temporarily and return at a chosen time, and snoozed mail can be found with `in:snoozed`. Nothing in the pack documents follow-up reminders that resurface a thread when nobody replies, so only half the story is evidenced. missing for 10: no-reply follow-up reminders that resurface a thread, independent or hands-on corroboration of native snooze.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: When you snooze an email, the email is removed from your inbox temporarily in Gmail.
Your email comes back to the top of your inbox when you want it to, whether that's tomorrow, next week, or in the evening.
To search for snoozed emails, at the top, in the search bar, enter `in:snoozed`.
